affected_version: Exact published 0.5.2 tarball contains the same unrestricted hashArchiveFile read before ZIP limits and raw stat. Candidate reproduced before patch; earlier releases unassessed.
invariant: Repository-authored archive sidecars cannot authorize external, linked or special-file reads. Validate raw metadata before path resolution and enforce bounded contained descriptor reads before computing digests.
strategy: Shared schema checks plus explicit archiveRoot for live parseNode consumers. Hash and ZIP-parse identical bounded bytes; stream raw hashing and byte count from one descriptor. Direct sidecar discovery/read uses contained bounded iteration/documents and filters legacy IDs before unrelated payload verification. Explicit external archive add and historical deferred parsing remain separate.
